camera.algorithmHint.en: Detection is temporarily unavailable and recovering
camera.algorithmHint.zh-CN: 算法观测暂不可用，正在恢复

camera.moved.en: Camera position changed. Confirm the detection regions in settings
camera.moved.zh-CN: 机位已变化，请到设置确认检测区域

camera.onlineFps.zh-CN: 相机在线 · 输出 {fps} fps

camera.readyHint.zh-CN: 画面准备好后自动显示

camera.recoveryHint.zh-CN: 连接与画面恢复后自动显示

config.cancelTitle.en: Discard local edits and reload device settings
config.cancelTitle.zh-CN: 放弃本页修改并重新读取设备配置

config.closeHint.en: Save to apply changes. Unsaved edits are retained when this panel closes.
config.closeHint.zh-CN: 保存后应用到设备，关闭面板会保留本页未保存的修改。

config.conflict.en: Settings conflict or expired reference frame. Select “Discard changes” to reload before saving.
config.conflict.zh-CN: 配置冲突或截图已过期，请点击“取消修改”重新加载后保存。

config.externalChange.en: Settings changed in another page. Select “Discard changes” to reload before saving.
config.externalChange.zh-CN: 设备配置已在其他页面更新，请点击“取消修改”重新加载后保存。

config.heading.en: Adapt the camera to your workstation

config.impact.en: Saving regions, timing or detection parameters ends the current work session and restarts confirmation with the new configuration.
config.impact.zh-CN: 保存区域、时长或检测参数将结束当前工作会话，并按新配置重新确认开工。

config.intro.en: Define regions, adjust timing rules, and manage privacy and detection layers.
config.intro.zh-CN: 划定观察范围，调整计时规则，统一管理画面隐私与检测图层。

config.loadFailed.en: Could not load settings. Check the device connection and retry.
config.loadFailed.zh-CN: 读取设置失败，请检查设备连接后重试。

config.persist.en: Settings are stored on the device and restored after restart.
config.persist.zh-CN: 本页配置保存在设备，重启后自动加载。

config.positionWarning.en: Camera position or image size changed. Capture a new frame and confirm the regions.
config.positionWarning.zh-CN: 机位或画面尺寸变化，请重新取图、检查并确认区域。

config.saved.en: Saved. All viewers will receive the new settings.
config.saved.zh-CN: 已保存，所有观看者将同步新设置。

config.savedTiming.en: Saved and applied. The current session is settled and work confirmation will use the new configuration.
config.savedTiming.zh-CN: 已保存并应用，当前会话已结算，将按新配置重新确认开工。

config.shared.en: Device settings · shared with all viewers
config.shared.zh-CN: 设备级设置 · 所有观看者同步

detection.allFields.en: Submit both person and keypoint confidence values.
detection.allFields.zh-CN: 需要同时提交人体与关键点置信度。

detection.invalid.en: Detection confidence must be within the supported range, from {minimum} to 1.00.
detection.invalid.zh-CN: 检测置信度需在允许范围内，最低为 {minimum}，最高为 1.00。

detection.invalidInput.en: Enter valid numbers. Person confidence must be 0.10–1.00 and keypoint confidence must be 0.25–1.00.
detection.invalidInput.zh-CN: 人体置信度范围为 0.10–1.00，关键点置信度范围为 0.25–1.00，请填写有效数值。

detection.invalidPrivacy.en: Invalid privacy localization threshold. Check the device configuration.
detection.invalidPrivacy.zh-CN: 隐私定位阈值配置无效，请检查设备配置。

detection.keypointHelp.en: Only keypoints at or above this score contribute to presence decisions and pose display. The extraction pipeline supports 0.25–1.00.
detection.keypointHelp.zh-CN: 仅分数达到阈值的关键点参与在位判断和姿态显示。当前提取流程支持的范围为 0.25–1.00。

detection.note.en: Higher thresholds filter more low-score results and can miss distant, side-facing or occluded people. These controls affect timing and detection overlays. Privacy mosaics use independent conservative candidates. Saving settles the current session and restarts work confirmation.
detection.note.zh-CN: 调高阈值会过滤更多低分结果，也可能漏掉远处、侧身或遮挡人员。参数影响计时与检测标注，隐私马赛克使用独立的保守候选。保存后结算当前会话并重新确认开工。

detection.noteTitle.zh-CN: 按场景调整筛选严格程度

detection.personHelp.en: Only person detections at or above this score contribute to timing and person boxes. Range 0.10–1.00.
detection.personHelp.zh-CN: 仅分数达到阈值的人体结果参与计时与人体框显示。范围 0.10–1.00。

display.keypointsHelp.zh-CN: 关节、骨架与上半身判断点

display.note.en: Display switches control the annotation layers. With privacy enabled, the device masks heads and faces and hides facial keypoints. Check masking under actual occlusion conditions.
display.note.zh-CN: 显示开关只控制画面图层。隐私开启时，头脸打码由设备完成，脸部关键点在展示层隐藏。自动打码效果需结合现场遮挡情况验证。

display.regionsHelp.en: Station area, presence zone and region names
display.regionsHelp.zh-CN: 工位范围、在位判断区及区域名称

display.seatHelp.zh-CN: 在位判断区蒙版、边界及名称

display.stationHelp.zh-CN: 工位范围渐变蒙版及名称

error.ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.en: This action is unavailable in the current state
error.ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 当前状态无法执行该操作

error.BAD_REQUEST.zh-CN: 请求参数无效，请检查输入。

error.FRAME_EXPIRED.en: The matching frame expired. Retrieve a new one.
error.FRAME_EXPIRED.zh-CN: 对应帧已过期，请重新获取

error.NOT_FOUND.en: The requested resource was not found

error.ORIGIN_REJECTED.en: Submit requests from this device's page
error.ORIGIN_REJECTED.zh-CN: 请从本设备页面提交请求

error.SETTINGS_CONFLICT.en: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
error.SETTINGS_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 配置已被其他页面修改，请刷新后重新保存

error.SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED.en: Save failed. Check storage and retry.
error.SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED.zh-CN: 保存失败，请检查存储状态后重试

error.STORAGE_ERROR.en: Save failed. Check device storage and retry.
error.STORAGE_ERROR.zh-CN: 保存失败，请检查设备存储后重试

error.allTiming.en: timing must contain all five timing values
error.allTiming.zh-CN: timing 必须包含全部五项时长

error.display.en: display requires boolean boxes, regions and keypoints switches
error.display.zh-CN: display 需要 boxes、regions、keypoints 布尔开关

error.end.zh-CN: 当前没有进行中的会话

error.generic.en: The operation could not be completed. Please retry.

error.imageSize.en: image_size must contain valid source image dimensions
error.imageSize.zh-CN: image_size 必须是有效原图尺寸

error.language.en: Unsupported language. Use zh-CN or en
error.language.zh-CN: 不支持该语言，请使用 zh-CN 或 en

error.regions.en: Provide both station and seat regions
error.regions.zh-CN: 必须提供工位范围 station 和在位判断区 seat

error.review.en: There is no session to review

error.staleReference.en: Camera or frame dimensions changed. Capture a new frame before saving regions
error.staleReference.zh-CN: 相机或截图尺寸已变化，请重新取图后保存区域

error.start.en: A person must be present with no active session
error.start.zh-CN: 需坐席在位且尚未开始会话

error.timingOrder.en: End timeout must exceed absence confirmation and missed-detection grace
error.timingOrder.zh-CN: 结束等待时间必须大于暂离确认时间和漏检缓冲时间

error.unknownField.en: The settings request contains unknown fields
error.unknownField.zh-CN: 设置请求包含未知字段

error.vertexNumber.en: {region} vertices must contain finite numeric coordinates

help.anchorDescription.en: The small amber marker is the timing reference, preferably the midpoint of the shoulders.
help.anchorDescription.zh-CN: 琥珀色小圆点为计时参考位置，优先使用双肩中点。

help.personDescription.en: Teal corner brackets mark people. Fine lines and dots show pose keypoints when enabled.
help.personDescription.zh-CN: 青绿色角框标示人员，细线与小圆点表示开启显示的姿态关键点。

help.seat.en: The thin teal outline and subtle fill identify the presence zone.
help.seat.zh-CN: 青绿色细实线与淡填充为在位判断区，用于判断人员是否在位。

help.sessionMeaning.en: Time is accumulated for presence-based work sessions. “Session ended” marks the end of that timing session.
help.sessionMeaning.zh-CN: 按在位工作会话累计时间。“会话结束”表示本次计时结束。

help.station.en: A soft gradient marks the station area, with feathered edges and no dashed outline.
help.station.zh-CN: 柔和渐变蒙版标示工位范围，边缘淡出，不显示外围虚线。

help.step1.en: Open settings and capture the current camera frame.
help.step1.zh-CN: 进入设置，获取当前相机画面。

help.step2.en: Define the station area and presence zone, then confirm the camera position.
help.step2.zh-CN: 划定工位范围和在位判断区，确认机位。

help.step3.en: Adjust timing, privacy and display options, then save to begin observation.
help.step3.zh-CN: 调整确认时长、隐私和显示选项，保存后开始观测。

mock.label.zh-CN: 前端联调 · 模拟情景

operation.preview.zh-CN: 纯预览 · 检测已关闭

operation.resetDone.zh-CN: 时间已清零，历史记录已保留

operation.resetHelp.en: Save and end the current session, then reset the displayed timers. History and production records are retained. A new start must be confirmed; detection stays off if disabled.
operation.resetHelp.zh-CN: 结算当前会话并清零当前显示，历史工时和产量记录保留。随后重新确认开工；检测关闭时保持关闭。

ownership.absent.en: Session operator not observed; other people do not reset the absence timer
ownership.absent.zh-CN: 未观察到本次会话操作员，其他人员不重置离开计时

ownership.confirmButton.en: Confirm selected person as the session operator
ownership.confirmButton.zh-CN: 确认所选人员为原操作员

ownership.confirmRequired.en: Confirm operator return; the original absence timer continues
ownership.confirmRequired.zh-CN: 等待确认操作员返回，原离开计时继续

ownership.confirmed.zh-CN: 已人工确认本次操作员返回

ownership.instructions.en: Check the person in the matching image and choose their track. Confirmation applies to this session only.
ownership.instructions.zh-CN: 请在下方配对画面中核对人员，再选择对应轨迹。确认只适用于当前会话。

ownership.nearby.en: Session operator is near the workstation
ownership.nearby.zh-CN: 本次会话操作员在工位附近

ownership.noCandidates.en: No eligible person in the presence zone. Refresh shortly.
ownership.noCandidates.zh-CN: 当前没有可确认的在位人员，请稍后刷新

ownership.present.en: Session operator is in the presence zone

ownership.staleConfirmation.en: Confirmation expired or the session changed. Refresh and select again.
ownership.staleConfirmation.zh-CN: 确认已过期或会话状态已变化，请刷新后重新选择

ownership.unverifiedHistory.en: Historical record lacks track evidence; ownership is unverified
ownership.unverifiedHistory.zh-CN: 历史记录缺少轨迹证据，人员归属无法验证

ownership.waiting.en: Waiting for a continuously tracked operator
ownership.waiting.zh-CN: 等待可连续跟踪的操作员

privacy.descriptionOff.en: Output may contain identifiable people when disabled.
privacy.descriptionOff.zh-CN: 关闭后，设备输出可包含可识别的人像。

privacy.descriptionOn.en: The device outputs head- and face-masked frames when enabled.
privacy.descriptionOn.zh-CN: 开启后，设备统一输出头脸脱敏画面。

privacy.scope.en: Applies to live video, snapshots and newly saved media
privacy.scope.zh-CN: 统一控制直播、截图和新增保存素材

production.activityRule.en: Based on hand–material interaction; occlusion and insufficient evidence are unknown
production.activityRule.zh-CN: 依据手部与物料交互；遮挡或证据不足记为未知

production.empty.en: Completion events and review evidence appear here after a session starts.
production.empty.zh-CN: 会话开始后，完成事件与待复核画面会显示在这里。

production.eventHint.zh-CN: 待复核优先 · 最近事件

production.evidenceAlt.zh-CN: 事件发生时的检测画面

production.evidenceWarning.en: Evidence images are unavailable. Please review later.
production.evidenceWarning.zh-CN: 证据画面暂不可用，请稍后复核。

production.noEvidence.en: No evidence image is currently available for this event.
production.noEvidence.zh-CN: 此事件暂时没有可用的证据画面。

production.paused.zh-CN: 观测暂停 · 保留已确认记录

production.reason.completed.en: Observed in the assembly area and then stable in the completed area.
production.reason.completed.zh-CN: 已观察到装配区记录与稳定进入成品区的过程。

production.reason.completion_unverified.en: Item appeared in the completed area without a verified path. Check whether it is newly completed.
production.reason.completion_unverified.zh-CN: 物品进入成品区，但缺少完整过程证据。请核对是否为本次新完成。

production.reason.counted_became_abnorma.en: The classification of a counted item changed. Check whether it should be removed.
production.reason.counted_became_abnorma.zh-CN: 已计数物品的分类发生变化，请核对是否需要扣除。

production.reason.identity_ambiguous.en: Nearby items could not be distinguished. Check whether a newly completed item was added.
production.reason.identity_ambiguous.zh-CN: 相邻物品身份难以区分，请核对是否产生新的完成件。

production.reason.initial.en: Finished items present at session start; inventory only.
production.reason.initial.zh-CN: 会话开始时已有的成品，仅记录库存。

production.reason.label_conflict.en: Conflicting object classifications; completion is unconfirmed.
production.reason.label_conflict.zh-CN: 物品分类冲突，尚未确认完成。

production.reason.return.en: A previously recorded item may have returned. Check whether it is newly completed.
production.reason.return.zh-CN: 疑似已记录物品再次出现，请核对是否为新完成。

production.rule.en: Completion events only; starting inventory excluded
production.rule.zh-CN: 按完成事件累计，开始时的库存不计入

quality.budget.zh-CN: 处理预算不足，物料降频

quality.help.en: Capture, encoder output and browser playback are measured separately. Encoder output is zero without viewers.
quality.help.zh-CN: 采集、编码发送与浏览器播放分别测量；无观看连接时编码发送为0。

reason.ambiguous.en: Insufficient keypoints or multiple people prevent assignment
reason.ambiguous.zh-CN: 关键点不足或工位内多人无法归属

reason.interrupted.en: Video interrupted. Waiting for a new session
reason.interrupted.zh-CN: 视频流中断，等待新会话

reason.missing.en: No worker observed in a valid frame
reason.missing.zh-CN: 有效画面中未观察到工位人员

reason.moved.en: Camera may have moved. inspect and confirm the regions
reason.moved.zh-CN: 机位可能移动，请检查区域并重新确认

reason.nearby.en: Person is inside the station area but outside the presence zone
reason.nearby.zh-CN: 人员在工位区域但不在坐席区域

reason.seated.en: Upper-body anchor is inside the presence zone
reason.seated.zh-CN: 上半身锚点位于初始坐席区域

reason.size.en: Image size changed. Confirm the detection regions
reason.size.zh-CN: 画面尺寸变化，需要重新确认区域

reason.stale.en: No fresh detection observation for over {seconds} seconds
reason.stale.zh-CN: 超过{seconds}秒无新鲜算法观测

reason.storage.zh-CN: 观测存储异常，暂停计时

roi.capturing.zh-CN: 正在获取当前相机截图…

roi.confirmed.en: Regions confirmed locally. Save to apply them to the device.
roi.confirmed.zh-CN: 区域已在本页确认，请保存以应用到设备。

roi.containment.en: The presence zone must be inside the station area
roi.containment.zh-CN: 在位判断区必须位于工位范围内

roi.edgeContainment.en: The presence zone boundary must stay inside the station area
roi.edgeContainment.zh-CN: 在位判断区边界必须位于工位范围内

roi.editHint.en: Drag a vertex of the selected region to adjust its boundary.
roi.editHint.zh-CN: 按住并拖动当前区域的顶点，微调边界。

roi.needsFrame.en: Capture a new camera frame before confirming regions.
roi.needsFrame.zh-CN: 请重新获取相机截图后确认区域。

roi.noFullscreen.en: Fullscreen editing is unavailable in this browser.
roi.noFullscreen.zh-CN: 当前浏览器暂不支持全屏编辑。

roi.notes.en: Keep the presence zone inside the station area. Coordinates use the source image and stay aligned when resized. Capturing a frame freezes the editor while detection continues.
roi.notes.zh-CN: 在位判断区应位于工位范围内。坐标按原图保存，缩放页面后仍与画面对齐。取图只冻结编辑画面，后台检测持续运行。

roi.offline.en: Camera offline. Reconnect and capture a new frame.
roi.offline.zh-CN: 相机暂时离线，请连接后重新取图。

roi.polygonHint.en: Click to add vertices. Click the first point or “Finish polygon” to close it.
roi.polygonHint.zh-CN: 逐点点击添加顶点，点击起点或“完成多边形”闭合区域。

roi.preparing.en: The protected frame is being prepared. Capture again shortly.
roi.preparing.zh-CN: 脱敏画面正在准备，请稍后重新取图。

roi.rectangleHint.en: Press and drag to draw a rectangle. Mouse and touch are supported.
roi.rectangleHint.zh-CN: 在画面上按住并拖动，绘制矩形区域。支持鼠标与触摸。

roi.revisionChanged.en: Configuration changed. Reload settings and capture a new frame.
roi.revisionChanged.zh-CN: 配置刚刚变化，请刷新配置后重新取图。

roi.saveNeedsFrame.en: Capture a new camera frame before saving regions.
roi.saveNeedsFrame.zh-CN: 请重新获取相机截图，再保存区域。

roi.seatHelp.en: Outline where the upper-body anchor should fall to confirm presence. Keep this zone inside the station area.
roi.seatHelp.zh-CN: 圈出上半身判断点应落入的区域，用于当前在位开工判断。该区域应位于工位范围内。

roi.sizeChanged.en: Image size changed. Redraw both regions.
roi.sizeChanged.zh-CN: 画面尺寸变化，请重新划定两个区域。

roi.stationHelp.en: Outline the full workstation area, including standing and nearby activity.
roi.stationHelp.zh-CN: 圈出本工位的完整活动范围，包含人员站起与附近活动的位置。

roi.streamChanged.en: Camera connection changed. Capture a new frame.
roi.streamChanged.zh-CN: 相机连接已变化，请重新取图。

roi.unfinished.en: Finish or cancel the current polygon first.
roi.unfinished.zh-CN: 请先完成或取消正在绘制的多边形。

session.autoStart.en: Starts after {seconds} seconds of continuous presence
session.autoStart.zh-CN: 连续在位 {seconds} 秒后自动开始

source.busy.en: A connection test is in progress. Try again shortly.
source.busy.zh-CN: 已有连接测试正在进行，请稍后重试。

source.connectionFailed.en: Unable to read a frame. Check the URL, credentials, codec, network and connection limit. The previous source is retained.
source.connectionFailed.zh-CN: 无法读取摄像头画面，请检查地址、凭据、编码、网络及连接数限制。原摄像头配置保留。

source.help.en: Choose a camera and test the connection, then save to switch. Switching ends the current session, resets the ROI draft and requires region confirmation.
source.help.zh-CN: 选择摄像头并测试连接，通过后点击保存并切换。切换会结束当前会话并重置区域草稿，需要重新确认检测区域。

source.invalid.en: Invalid camera settings. Check the URL, type and codec.
source.invalid.zh-CN: 摄像头参数无效，请检查地址、类型和编码。

source.needsTest.en: Input changed. Test the connection first.
source.needsTest.zh-CN: 配置已修改，请先测试连接。

source.networkHelp.en: IP cameras need network connectivity to this device. Use a PoE switch or injector for power. If testing fails, check the URL, credentials, codec and camera connection limit.
source.networkHelp.zh-CN: 网络摄像头需与设备网络互通，PoE 供电由交换机或供电器提供。测试失败请检查地址、凭据、编码和摄像头连接数限制。

source.noUsb.en: No supported USB camera found. Connect one and refresh.
source.noUsb.zh-CN: 未发现可用的 USB 摄像头，请插入设备后刷新。

source.otherDraft.en: Save or cancel privacy, display, timing and detection parameter changes before switching cameras.
source.otherDraft.zh-CN: 请先保存或取消隐私、显示、时长及检测参数修改，再切换摄像头。

source.passwordHelp.en: Leave blank to keep the password for the same URL and username.
source.passwordHelp.zh-CN: 同一地址和用户名，密码留空保留原密码。

source.roiRequired.en: Draw and save detection regions for the new camera to resume automatic timing.
source.roiRequired.zh-CN: 请在新摄像头画面上重新划定并保存检测区域，确认后恢复自动计时。

source.separateSave.en: Save the camera source separately from other settings.
source.separateSave.zh-CN: 请单独保存摄像头配置，其他设置请分别保存。

source.switched.en: Camera saved. Confirm the detection regions.
source.switched.zh-CN: 摄像头已保存，请重新确认检测区域。

source.testExpired.en: The test expired or the input changed. Test again.
source.testExpired.zh-CN: 连接测试已过期或参数已修改，请重新测试。

source.testPassed.en: Connected at {width} × {height}. Save within 90 seconds to switch.
source.testPassed.zh-CN: 连接成功，画面 {width} × {height}，请在90秒内保存切换。

source.testing.en: Reading a frame from the candidate camera…
source.testing.zh-CN: 正在读取候选摄像头画面…

source.usbUnavailable.en: USB device or format unavailable. Refresh the device list.
source.usbUnavailable.zh-CN: USB 设备或采集格式不可用，请刷新设备列表。

startup.noTrack.en: Person detected in presence zone; waiting for a reliable track ID
startup.noTrack.zh-CN: 已检测到在位人员，但尚无可靠轨迹编号

startup.review.zh-CN: 查看画面并确认检测区域

startup.trackChanged.en: Candidate track changed; confirming presence again
startup.trackChanged.zh-CN: 候选人员轨迹变化，重新确认在位

studio.annotationHelp.en: Drag boxes around every product. Select a box to move it, or drag a corner to resize. Confirm empty images explicitly. Changes save automatically before navigating.
studio.annotationHelp.zh-CN: 拖动框出每一个产品。点击已有框可移动，拖动角点可缩放。无产品的图片点击“确认无目标”。修改自动保存，切换图片前会等待保存。

studio.annotationKeys.en: Select a class before drawing. W: new box; A/D: images; Delete: remove; Ctrl/⌘+Z: undo; Ctrl/⌘+S: save.
studio.annotationKeys.zh-CN: 先选择类别再画框。W 新框，A/D 切图，Delete 删除，Ctrl/⌘+Z 撤销，Ctrl/⌘+S 保存。

studio.annotationReady.en: Capture complete. You can now annotate the images.
studio.annotationReady.zh-CN: 采集已完成，现在可以统一标注图片。

studio.assemblyFlow.en: Select model → draw two zones → assign count or alert roles → save. Reassign classes after changing models.
studio.assemblyFlow.zh-CN: 选择模型 → 划定两区 → 为标签选择统计或提醒 → 保存。切换模型后须重新分配标签。

studio.baseHelp.en: YOLO11n is the default. Larger m / l models require resource checks. Pretrained weights are a starting point, not a detector already trained for your product.
studio.baseHelp.zh-CN: 默认 YOLO11n。m／l 更大，需通过设备资源检查。官方预训练模型是训练起点，并不表示已能识别你的产品。

studio.captureFlowHelp.en: Open the live preview, take photos or capture continuously, then annotate the collected images.
studio.captureFlowHelp.zh-CN: 先打开相机预览，拍照或连续采集；完成采集后再统一标注。

studio.captureHelp.en: Uses the configured camera. Saves full-frame, privacy-processed images without overlays. Start a new group after rearranging the scene; prepare at least three independent groups.
studio.captureHelp.zh-CN: 使用已配置的摄像头，保留完整画面及设备隐私处理，不写入检测图层。每次重新摆放后开始新采集组，至少准备3组独立场景。

studio.captureSummary.en: {saved} added this session · {total} images in project
studio.captureSummary.zh-CN: 本次新增 {saved} 张 · 项目共 {total} 张

studio.captured.en: Image captured; exact duplicates are removed
studio.captured.zh-CN: 图片已采集，重复图片会自动去重

studio.checkingModel.zh-CN: 正在上传并检查模型兼容性…

studio.classThreshold.en: Class confidence threshold (at least the global threshold)
studio.classThreshold.zh-CN: 类别识别门槛（不低于整体门槛）

studio.configureTagsInAssembly.en: Configure class rules in Assembly counting
studio.configureTagsInAssembly.zh-CN: 标签规则请在装配计数中配置

studio.countRule.en: Count selected classes per zone. Stable finished items increase the session total, including initial inventory. Removal does not subtract. Alert classes never count as accepted items.
studio.countRule.zh-CN: 按区域分别统计选中标签。成品稳定进入后累计，取走不扣减；初始成品计入本会话。异常标签只提醒，不计合格数量。

studio.deployHelp.en: Training never replaces the live model automatically. Check independent test metrics and a live-scene preview before activating. Confirm counting zones and class.
studio.deployHelp.zh-CN: 训练完成后不会自动替换生产模型。先查看独立测试指标和现场预览，再选择投用。区域与计数类别仍需确认。

studio.deployed.en: Model activated. Confirm zones and product class.
studio.deployed.zh-CN: 模型已启用，请确认计数区域与产品类别

studio.downloading.zh-CN: 下载已开始，可在此查看进度

studio.drawRegions.en: Reference captured. Draw both material zones.
studio.drawRegions.zh-CN: 参考画面已冻结，请划定两个物料区域

studio.error.adjustment.en: An adjustment needs a valid session, integer amount and reason; total cannot be negative
studio.error.adjustment.zh-CN: 调整需要有效会话、整数数量和原因，且总量不能为负

studio.error.agentOffline.en: Training service is offline; install or start it
studio.error.agentOffline.zh-CN: 训练后台服务未运行，请安装或启动训练服务

studio.error.annotationIncomplete.en: {count} images are unconfirmed. Label them, confirm empty, or delete them
studio.error.annotationIncomplete.zh-CN: 还有 {count} 张图片未确认，请完成标注、确认无目标或删除

studio.error.annotationInvalid.en: Invalid bounding boxes; check image boundaries
studio.error.annotationInvalid.zh-CN: 标注框无效，请检查是否超出图片范围

studio.error.baseModel.zh-CN: 请选择已下载的官方基础权重

studio.error.busy.en: A training or model operation is active; retry later
studio.error.busy.zh-CN: 训练或模型操作进行中，请稍后重试

studio.error.checkpoint.zh-CN: 没有可恢复的有效检查点

studio.error.checksum.en: Checksum mismatch; download again or verify data
studio.error.checksum.zh-CN: 文件校验不一致，请重新下载或检查数据

studio.error.classInvalid.en: Use a unique class name of 1–100 characters
studio.error.classInvalid.zh-CN: 类别名称不能为空或重复，最多100个字符

studio.error.classMissing.en: Selected class is not present in this model
studio.error.classMissing.zh-CN: 模型中不存在所选产品类别

studio.error.classReferenced.en: Class is used by annotations or snapshots, or is the last class; cannot delete
studio.error.classReferenced.zh-CN: 该类别仍被标注或快照引用，或为项目最后一个类别，不能删除

studio.error.conflict.en: Content changed. Refresh before retrying; your draft is retained.
studio.error.conflict.zh-CN: 内容已被修改，请刷新后重试；当前草稿仍保留

studio.error.cuda.en: CUDA unavailable; training did not start

studio.error.datasetInvalid.en: Select a project or enter its name and product class
studio.error.datasetInvalid.zh-CN: 请先选择项目，或填写项目名称及产品名称

studio.error.diskSpace.en: Insufficient disk space; at least 2 GB is required
studio.error.diskSpace.zh-CN: 磁盘可用空间不足，至少需要2 GB

studio.error.downloadFailed.en: Download failed; check internet access and retry
studio.error.downloadFailed.zh-CN: 下载失败，请检查外网连接并重试

studio.error.fileSize.en: File limit exceeded: models 512 MB; images 20 MB / 24 MP
studio.error.fileSize.zh-CN: 文件超过限制：模型512 MB，图片20 MB／2400万像素

studio.error.frameUnavailable.en: No fresh privacy-processed frame; wait for the camera
studio.error.frameUnavailable.zh-CN: 没有可用的最新脱敏画面，请等待摄像头连接

studio.error.gpuBusy.en: GPU was not released; training did not start

studio.error.idempotency.en: Invalid operation identifier; refresh and retry
studio.error.idempotency.zh-CN: 操作标识无效，请刷新后重试

studio.error.imageInvalid.en: Invalid image; use JPEG / PNG within size limits
studio.error.imageInvalid.zh-CN: 图片无效，仅支持限额内的 JPEG／PNG

studio.error.interrupted.en: Job interrupted; resume from the last complete checkpoint
studio.error.interrupted.zh-CN: 任务中断，可从最近完整检查点恢复

studio.error.materialsInvalid.zh-CN: 物料参数不合法，请检查范围及区域

studio.error.materialsOverlap.en: Material zones must not overlap or intersect
studio.error.materialsOverlap.zh-CN: 两个物料区域不能重叠或相交

studio.error.materialsRoi.en: Define and confirm both material zones first
studio.error.materialsRoi.zh-CN: 请先划定并确认两个物料区域

studio.error.memory.en: Training ran out of memory. Create a job with a smaller batch or model
studio.error.memory.zh-CN: 训练内存不足，请新建任务降低 Batch 或选择较小模型

studio.error.modelActivation.en: Model trial failed. The previous model was restored and material counting paused. Check compatibility and device resources.
studio.error.modelActivation.zh-CN: 模型试运行失败，已恢复原模型并暂停物料计数；请检查模型兼容性与设备资源。

studio.error.modelInvalid.en: Compatibility check failed. Use compatible YOLO11 Detect or COCO 17-keypoint Pose .pt weights
studio.error.modelInvalid.zh-CN: 模型检查失败，仅支持兼容的 YOLO11 Detect／COCO 17点 Pose .pt 权重

studio.error.modelMissing.en: Model missing or incompatible; upload a compatible model
studio.error.modelMissing.zh-CN: 模型未安装或不匹配，请先上传兼容模型

studio.error.referenced.en: Built-in or referenced models cannot be deleted
studio.error.referenced.zh-CN: 该模型为内置或仍被配置、训练及恢复任务引用，不能删除

studio.error.request.zh-CN: 请求不合法，请检查输入

studio.error.splitGroups.en: At least three independent capture groups are required
studio.error.splitGroups.zh-CN: 至少需要3个独立采集组，请重新摆放并分组采集

studio.error.splitInvalid.en: Split percentages must be positive integers totalling 100%
studio.error.splitInvalid.zh-CN: 三个比例需为正整数，且合计为100%

studio.error.splitPositive.en: At least three independent groups need annotated products for train, validation and test
studio.error.splitPositive.zh-CN: 至少3个独立采集组需有已标注产品，供训练、验证和测试使用

studio.error.staleReference.en: Reference expired or camera changed; capture a new reference
studio.error.staleReference.zh-CN: 参考画面已过期或机位变化，请重新取图并确认

studio.error.storage.en: Device file or database operation failed; check storage
studio.error.storage.zh-CN: 设备文件或数据库操作失败，请检查存储

studio.error.trainingFailed.en: Training failed. Review the log; the original live model will resume
studio.error.trainingFailed.zh-CN: 训练失败，请查看日志，原生产模型将恢复

studio.error.trainingParams.en: Invalid epochs, learning rate or batch size
studio.error.trainingParams.zh-CN: 训练参数不合法，请检查轮数、学习率及 Batch

studio.error.workerStart.en: Unable to start the training process; check the environment and service log
studio.error.workerStart.zh-CN: 无法启动训练进程，请检查设备环境与服务日志

studio.group.en: Capture group {group}; images in this group stay in the same split
studio.group.zh-CN: 当前采集组 {group}；同组图片不会跨数据集合

studio.installedModel.zh-CN: 模型已安装，可直接使用

studio.materialsBrief.zh-CN: 划定区域 · 计数与核对

studio.modelHelp.en: Upload trusted, compatible YOLO11 weights only. Person models require COCO 17-keypoint pose. Uploading runs a compatibility check and does not activate the model.
studio.modelHelp.zh-CN: 仅上传可信来源的兼容 YOLO11 权重。人员模型需包含 COCO 17关键点。上传后独立检查兼容性，不立即投用。

studio.modelsBrief.zh-CN: 上传 · 选择 · 切换模型

studio.noCountSession.en: No active work session. Only current zone quantities are counted.
studio.noCountSession.zh-CN: 当前无活动工时会话，仅显示区域数量。

studio.peakMemory.zh-CN: 训练峰值 GPU 分配

studio.previewHelp.en: Camera view without detection overlays; configured privacy protection remains. Localhost and LAN use HD; Tailscale uses a compressed preview. Photos always keep their full resolution.
studio.previewHelp.zh-CN: 无检测标注的相机画面，保留隐私处理。本机和局域网高清，Tailscale预览压缩；拍照始终保存完整原分辨率。

studio.previewUnavailable.en: Waiting for the camera to recover
studio.previewUnavailable.zh-CN: 暂时无法获取画面，正在等待相机恢复

studio.previewing.zh-CN: 正在使用当前脱敏画面验证…

studio.reason.training.zh-CN: 本地训练中，业务检测已暂停

studio.regionsHelp.en: Draw non-overlapping materials and finished zones. Box centers determine membership; assign count and alert classes per zone.
studio.regionsHelp.zh-CN: 圈定待装配区和成品区，两区不可重叠。框中心点决定归属；每区独立选择统计与异常标签。

studio.remapTags.en: Reassign zone classes for this model and save. Assembly counting is disabled.
studio.remapTags.zh-CN: 请为新模型重新选择区域标签并保存；当前装配计数已关闭。

studio.snapshotMade.zh-CN: 快照已保存：训练 {train} 张／验证 {val} 张／测试 {test} 张

studio.snapshotReady.en: Snapshot created; later edits do not change this version
studio.snapshotReady.zh-CN: 快照已生成，后续改标注不会影响此版本

studio.splitHelp.en: Drag to adjust the training share or enter all three percentages. Whole capture groups stay together; actual proportions depend on group sizes. Every split needs positive samples.
studio.splitHelp.zh-CN: 拖动调整训练占比，或输入三个比例。按采集组划分，连续图片不会跨集合；实际占比取决于组大小。每个集合都需要有目标样本。

studio.stabilityHelp.en: Products are detected on every processed new frame; actual speed depends on device load. Counts and classes use multi-frame voting, retaining confirmed counts through brief misclassifications and misses.
studio.stabilityHelp.zh-CN: 每个实际处理的新帧连续检测物料，实际检测速度取决于设备负载。数量和类别通过多帧投票确认；短时误识别和漏检在缓冲期内保留已确认数量。

studio.startConfirm.en: Training ends the current work session and pauses business detection and live video. Start now?
studio.startConfirm.zh-CN: 开始训练将结算当前工作会话，并暂停业务检测和直播。是否现在开始？

studio.switchHelp.en: Activate a compatible model. Switching ends the current session and resets tracking. A failed switch restores the previous model.
studio.switchHelp.zh-CN: 选择兼容模型后保存。实际切换会结算当前会话并重置追踪，失败时恢复原模型。

studio.trainingBrief.zh-CN: 采集 · 标注 · 本地训练

studio.trainingHelp.en: Trains locally on Jetson using AdamW, 640-pixel input and a fixed seed. Business detection and live video pause during training, then resume with the original model. Closing the browser does not stop training.
studio.trainingHelp.zh-CN: Jetson 本地训练，AdamW、640尺寸、固定种子。训练期间暂停业务检测与直播，正常结束或停止后恢复原生产模型。关闭网页不会停止训练。

studio.trainingStarted.en: Training submitted. Closing the browser does not stop it.
studio.trainingStarted.zh-CN: 训练任务已提交，关闭网页不会停止

studio.unavailable.zh-CN: 装配检测待确认／不可用

system.cpuHint.en: Total device CPU utilization across all cores. Refreshes about every 2 seconds.
system.cpuHint.zh-CN: 设备全部CPU核心的总体使用率，约每2秒刷新

system.gpuHint.en: Current GPU load reported by the Jetson driver. Refreshes about every 2 seconds.
system.gpuHint.zh-CN: Jetson GPU驱动报告的当前负载，约每2秒刷新

system.memoryHint.en: Used / total system RAM in GiB. Used RAM is total minus MemAvailable.
system.memoryHint.zh-CN: 系统已用内存 / 可用总物理内存，已用量按总量减MemAvailable计算，单位GiB

system.temperatureHint.en: Highest on-chip CPU, GPU or SoC sensor temperature. Refreshes about every 2 seconds.
system.temperatureHint.zh-CN: CPU、GPU及SoC片上传感器中的最高温度，约每2秒刷新

system.unavailable.en: Device metric is loading or unavailable. Refreshes about every 2 seconds.
system.unavailable.zh-CN: 设备指标读取中或暂不可用，约每2秒刷新

timing.ageHelp.en: Older results are treated as unknown
timing.ageHelp.zh-CN: 超过此时间的旧结果按未知处理

timing.awayHelp.en: Return within the window to count as work. Otherwise count as break
timing.awayHelp.zh-CN: 期内返回补计工作，超时改计休息

timing.graceHelp.en: Buffer for brief occlusion or missed detections
timing.graceHelp.zh-CN: 对短时遮挡或检测缺失的缓冲

timing.help.en: Start is confirmed after {start_seconds} seconds of presence. Returning within the {short_away_seconds}-second absence window counts that period as work. End after {stop_absent_seconds} seconds without observing a person. Missed-detection grace is {missing_grace_seconds} seconds. Observation validity is {max_observation_age} seconds.
timing.help.zh-CN: 连续在位 {start_seconds} 秒后确认开工。暂离确认期为 {short_away_seconds} 秒，期间返回会补计工作时间。连续未观察到人员 {stop_absent_seconds} 秒后结束会话。短时漏检缓冲 {missing_grace_seconds} 秒，观测有效时间 {max_observation_age} 秒。

timing.note.en: Returning during the absence confirmation window counts that period as work. After the window, the entire absence counts as break. These fields adjust the timing parameters.
timing.note.zh-CN: 当前规则下，暂离确认期内返回会补计工作时间；超过确认期，整段暂离计为休息。这里调整的是现有规则的时间参数。

timing.startHelp.zh-CN: 在位持续满足多久后自动开工

timing.stopHelp.en: Unobserved duration before ending a session
timing.stopHelp.zh-CN: 持续未观察到人员多久后结束会话

v4.healthNote.en: Historical time segments are not connected

v4.localCompute.zh-CN: 本地推理 · 现场计时

v4.metricsUnavailable.zh-CN: 尚未接入设备指标采集

v4.platform.zh-CN: 基于 NVIDIA Jetson 的工业边缘计算

v4.sessionOnly.en: Statistics cover the current session or the last completed session.
v4.sessionOnly.zh-CN: 统计范围为当前会话或最近一次已结束会话。

v4.timelineHint.en: The current API provides session totals
v4.timelineHint.zh-CN: 现有接口提供会话累计时长

v4.timelineUnavailable.en: Time segment data is not connected

video.background.en: Detection and timing continue in the background
video.background.zh-CN: 后台检测与计时持续运行

video.noFullscreen.en: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser
video.noFullscreen.zh-CN: 当前浏览器暂不支持全屏

video.renderQuality.zh-CN: 显示间隔 P95 {p95} ms · 停顿 >500ms：{stalls}

video.webrtcStats.en: WebRTC · {quality} · {fps} FPS · {kbps} Kbps · RTT {rtt} ms · Buffer {buffer} ms
video.webrtcStats.zh-CN: WebRTC · {quality} · {fps} FPS · {kbps} Kbps · RTT {rtt} ms · 缓冲 {buffer} ms

visualization.help.en: Choose colors for regions, people and pose. Preview, then save to apply.
visualization.help.zh-CN: 分别设置区域、人物与姿态颜色。预览后点击保存并应用。

visualization.invalid.en: Invalid colors or opacity. Choose valid values.
visualization.invalid.zh-CN: 配色或不透明度无效，请重新选择。
